resources.string: "Reading voice source"
"Phone and downloaded voices"
"Uses your existing voice selection. Phone TTS is the default."
"Connect my cloud voice account"
"Cloud reading enabled. Your provider bills your account."
"Optional. Requires your own provider account."
"How voices work"
"Choose how Vern reads"

"Vern starts with your phone’s selected text-to-speech engine. Its voices may work offline or need internet, and can include neural voices. Sound and languages depend on that engine. Explore voices to compare Lite, Studio and Kitten downloads, or connect your own cloud account."
"Personal cloud connection"
"Using this voice sends the passages you read to the selected provider. Preview also sends text and may incur a charge. Your API key stays encrypted on this device; it is excluded from backups."
"OpenAI-compatible TTS server"
"Expressive voices with multilingual models. An API account and a voice available to your account are required. Website subscriptions and API allowances can differ."
"Natural cloud narration with Sonic models. Choose a voice ID and the language of your book. API access and supported languages depend on your account and model."
"Expressive multilingual narration. This connection uses the international MiniMax endpoint. Enter a voice ID available to your API account."
"Hosted KittenML voices require an API account. This option uses the online service; it does not install an offline model on your phone."
"For a server you trust that accepts the OpenAI speech request format and returns MP3 audio. Enter the full HTTPS speech endpoint, model and voice ID. Compatibility depends on the server."
"Provider setup, voices and pricing ↗"
"Full HTTPS speech endpoint"
"API key"
"Leave blank to keep the saved key. Custom servers may not need one."
"Model ID"
"Voice ID"
"Book language code (optional, e.g. fr)"
"Use Wi-Fi for new cloud audio"
"Use phone TTS if cloud reading fails"
"Keep cloud audio for repeat reading"
"Optional device cache, up to 64 MB. Enable only if your provider permits storage. Cached passages can play without a new request; changing the voice or model generates new audio."
"Advanced connection settings"
"Network timeout in seconds (5–120)"
"Retries for rate limits (0–2)"
"Only explicit rate-limit responses are retried. Interrupted or timed-out speech requests are not automatically resent because the provider may already have charged for them."
"Your estimated cost per 1M characters (0 = off)"
"Test voice (may incur a charge)"
"Use this cloud voice for reading"

"Vern buffers one short passage before playback. Highlights follow passages, not exact words. Speed and pitch are adjusted on this device. Stop cancels further requests; audio already submitted may still be billed."
"Usage on this device"
"Submitted characters: %1$s · Requests: %2$s"
"Rough estimate using your rate: %1$s (in your rate’s currency)"

"Counts include previews and attempted submissions for this provider. This is not the provider’s bill or remaining balance. Credits, model rates and failed-request charges may differ. Check your provider dashboard."

"API key removed. Cloud reading is disabled for this connection."
"More voices for your phone"

"These links open external apps or sites. Install an engine, download its language data, then refresh the engine list below. Availability varies by country and device; internet voices may need a connection."
"Google Speech Services — broad language choice; download voices in Android TTS settings"
"RHVoice — offline voices for selected languages; most are free, some are paid"
"eSpeak NG — compact, many languages, clearly synthetic sound"

"Studio shares one package across its English voices. Expressive narration, but slower phones may pause while the next passage is generated."
"Lite downloads one English voice at a time, about 64–77 MB each. Usually lighter to run than Studio; pronunciation and naturalness vary by voice and text."
"Kitten Nano 0.8 includes eight English voices in one shared download. This offline model differs from Kitten’s cloud voices; speed and clarity depend on your phone and the text."

"Connection help"

"Use your own account key with permission to generate speech. Previews and reading send passage text to that provider and may incur charges. For a custom server, enter its full HTTPS speech endpoint, model and voice IDs. It must accept OpenAI-compatible speech requests and return MP3 or WAV. Other API formats need a dedicated adapter. Connect only to a server you trust with your text and key."
